raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What
`(H200 MIG 18GB) E2E Core` selected its tests with two `--ignore` flags and a `-k` filter. This PR moves the excluded files out of `tests/v1/e2e/general/` so every job runs whole files. It then splits E2E Core into a `Mamba Prefix Cache` job and three hash shards over the rest of `general/`, which keeps each job under the 20-minute target.

## Old
```
tests/v1/e2e/general/
├── test_async_scheduling.py        # E2E Scheduling
├── test_kv_sharing_fast_prefill.py # E2E Core Large Memory
├── test_mamba_prefix_cache.py      # mrv1 -> E2E Core, mrv2 -> Large Memory (via -k / node IDs)
└── ... (9 more)                    # E2E Core
e2e-core-1-gpu         E2E Core            pytest v1/e2e/general --ignore .../test_async_scheduling.py --ignore .../test_kv_sharing_fast_prefill.py -k "not test_mamba_prefix_cache_mrv2"
e2e-core-large-memory  Large Memory        pytest .../test_kv_sharing_fast_prefill.py
                                           pytest .../test_mamba_prefix_cache.py::test_mamba_prefix_cache_mrv2 .../test_mamba_prefix_cache.py::test_mamba_prefix_cache_mrv2_async
```

## New
```
tests/v1/e2e/
├── _mamba_prefix_cache.py            # shared body (not collected), was general/test_mamba_prefix_cache.py
├── test_async_scheduling.py          # E2E Scheduling
├── test_kv_sharing_fast_prefill.py   # E2E Core Large Memory
├── test_mamba_prefix_cache_mrv1.py   # E2E Core Mamba Prefix Cache (mrv1, mrv1_async)
├── test_mamba_prefix_cache_mrv2.py   # E2E Core Large Memory (mrv2, mrv2_async)
└── general/                          # E2E Core Shard %N (9 files, unchanged)
e2e-core-1-gpu               E2E Core Shard %N (x3)       pytest v1/e2e/general --num-shards=3 --shard-id=N
e2e-core-mamba-prefix-cache  E2E Core Mamba Prefix Cache  pytest v1/e2e/test_mamba_prefix_cache_mrv1.py
e2e-core-large-memory        Large Memory                 pytest v1/e2e/test_kv_sharing_fast_prefill.py
                                                          pytest v1/e2e/test_mamba_prefix_cache_mrv2.py
```
- **Mirrors:** each NVIDIA job keeps an MI250 mirror, and the new job gets its own (`amd-e2e-core-mamba-prefix-cache`). The E2E Core mirror stays unsharded, with an explicit `parallelism: 1` so the base count can't multiply it.
- **Legacy `test-amd.yaml`:** the MI250 E2E Core step adds the moved MRV1 wrapper as a second command. The other legacy steps only get path updates.

## Notes
- This combines filter removal and sharding in one PR. That is a deliberate exception to the usual two-PR split, because the file moves are small. The same test functions are claimed per lane, and a static check confirms it (39 E2E Core, 4 Large Memory, 3 Scheduling, none duplicated).
- `test_mamba_prefix_cache.py` → the `_mamba_prefix_cache.py` helper plus MRV1/MRV2 wrappers. The `_run_*` bodies stay in the helper because they mutate module globals that the shared fakes read.
- Why this count: MRV1 mamba is the largest single unit, and it's a distinct feature, so it gets its own job. Replaying pytest-shard's hash on recent `main` logs, 2 shards of the remainder would push the slowest shard over 20 minutes on a slow run; 3 keeps it under.
- `source_file_dependencies` now name the files each job runs, with the helper triggering both mamba jobs. Timeouts are lowered to fit the smaller jobs.

## Expected runtime and overhead
Predictions from per-case log timestamps on four recent `main` runs (fastest / slowest run). Estimates, not measurements.

| Job | pytest | running wall | non-pytest overhead | main overhead cause |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| E2E Core Shard 0 | 7–13m | 9–15m | ~2m | image pull + container start |
| E2E Core Shard 1 | 3–5m | 5–7m | ~2m | image pull + container start |
| E2E Core Shard 2 | 4–15m | 6–17m | ~2m | image pull + container start |
| E2E Core Mamba Prefix Cache | 7–19m | 9–21m | ~2m | image pull + container start |

- **Worker-minutes:** baseline 23–51 → about 29–57 after. That is about **+6 extra worker-minutes**, from three extra jobs' setup, within the 20-minute budget. Any fixture or model load repeated per shard inside pytest isn't measured yet; validation will show it.
- **Slowest replica:** about 19m pytest (Mamba Prefix Cache, slowest run), down from 21–49m for the single job.
- **Mirror lane:** the unsharded E2E Core mirror loses the MRV1 cases to the new mirror job, so its cost is roughly the old total plus one job's setup.

nodes.body:
## Validation

Build: [ci #91231](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/91231) (scoped to all 8 affected keys, including the four `amd-` mirrors) and [amd-ci #13621](https://buildkite.com/vllm/amd-ci/builds/13621) (the four legacy steps this PR edits, unblocked manually). Both run on `a600ca23ba`, and every job passed.

**Coverage.** Outcome counts match a same-day unsharded `main` run on every lane:
- **E2E Core:** Shards 1–3 give 21+16+11 passed, 1+3+1 skipped and 2+4+0 xpassed. With Mamba Prefix Cache's 2 passed, the total is **50 passed / 5 skipped / 6 xpassed**, the same as `main`'s single job.
- **MRV2 cases:** the 2 cases that `main` deselected here are now counted in Large Memory's 8 passed, which is unchanged.
- **Hash assignment:** the per-shard case counts (24 / 23 / 12) are exactly what the hash replay in the PR body predicted.
- **Mirrors and the legacy AMD steps:** the E2E Core mirror plus the new mirror sum to the same passed/skipped/xpassed as the old mirror. Scheduling and Large Memory counts are unchanged on all lanes.

**Primary lane, measured**

| Job | pytest | running wall | non-pytest overhead | main overhead cause | predicted pytest |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| E2E Core Shard 1 | 9.4m | 11.0m | 1.6m | image pull + container start | 7–13m |
| E2E Core Shard 2 | 6.6m | 7.8m | 1.2m | image pull + container start | 3–5m |
| E2E Core Shard 3 | 5.7m | 7.3m | 1.6m | image pull + container start | 4–15m |
| E2E Core Mamba Prefix Cache | 7.4m | 8.6m | 1.2m | image pull + container start | 7–19m |

(Shards 1–3 here are Shards 0–2 in the body's prediction table.)

- **Runtime:** the slowest replica ran 9.4m of pytest and 11.0m of wall, down from 21–49m of pytest for the single job on recent `main`. This passes the 20-minute target. Shard 2 ran above its predicted range. It holds the same cases the replay predicted, so the most likely cause is per-shard fixture and model-load time inside pytest.
- **Cost:** after the split, the four jobs total 34.7 worker-minutes, with 5.6m of non-pytest overhead. The old single job had about 1.5m of overhead. That makes the incremental setup cost about **+4 worker-minutes**, which passes the 20-minute budget. Pytest time varies a lot between `main` runs (21–49m for the same job), so this run's wall total isn't a matched comparison. The setup delta is the stable number.
- **Mirror lane:** every mirror replica passed. The E2E Core mirror and the new Mamba Prefix Cache mirror together cost about one extra job setup over the old unsharded mirror, and each finished well inside its timeout.

Runtime verdict: **pass**. Cost verdict: **pass**.

This pull request has merge conflicts that must be resolved before it can be
merged. Please rebase the PR, @Thangnguyenvn98.

https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/collaborating-with-pull-requests/working-with-forks/syncing-a-fork

Closing in favor of automatic runtime sharding: CI now plans each step's shards when the pipeline is generated, from main's per-file timings (`automatic_shard: true`), so hand-split jobs are no longer the approach. `e2e-core-1-gpu` is sharded automatically on main.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

## Validation

Build: [ci #91231](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/91231) (scoped to all 8 affected keys, including the four `amd-` mirrors) and [amd-ci #13621](https://buildkite.com/vllm/amd-ci/builds/13621) (the four legacy steps this PR edits, unblocked manually). Both run on `a600ca23ba`, and every job passed.

**Coverage.** Outcome counts match a same-day unsharded `main` run on every lane:
- **E2E Core:** Shards 1–3 give 21+16+11 passed, 1+3+1 skipped and 2+4+0 xpassed. With Mamba Prefix Cache's 2 passed, the total is **50 passed / 5 skipped / 6 xpassed**, the same as `main`'s single job.
- **MRV2 cases:** the 2 cases that `main` deselected here are now counted in Large Memory's 8 passed, which is unchanged.
- **Hash assignment:** the per-shard case counts (24 / 23 / 12) are exactly what the hash replay in the PR body predicted.
- **Mirrors and the legacy AMD steps:** the E2E Core mirror plus the new mirror sum to the same passed/skipped/xpassed as the old mirror. Scheduling and Large Memory counts are unchanged on all lanes.

**Primary lane, measured**

| Job | pytest | running wall | non-pytest overhead | main overhead cause | predicted pytest |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| E2E Core Shard 1 | 9.4m | 11.0m | 1.6m | image pull + container start | 7–13m |
| E2E Core Shard 2 | 6.6m | 7.8m | 1.2m | image pull + container start | 3–5m |
| E2E Core Shard 3 | 5.7m | 7.3m | 1.6m | image pull + container start | 4–15m |
| E2E Core Mamba Prefix Cache | 7.4m | 8.6m | 1.2m | image pull + container start | 7–19m |

(Shards 1–3 here are Shards 0–2 in the body's prediction table.)

- **Runtime:** the slowest replica ran 9.4m of pytest and 11.0m of wall, down from 21–49m of pytest for the single job on recent `main`. This passes the 20-minute target. Shard 2 ran above its predicted range. It holds the same cases the replay predicted, so the most likely cause is per-shard fixture and model-load time inside pytest.
- **Cost:** after the split, the four jobs total 34.7 worker-minutes, with 5.6m of non-pytest overhead. The old single job had about 1.5m of overhead. That makes the incremental setup cost about **+4 worker-minutes**, which passes the 20-minute budget. Pytest time varies a lot between `main` runs (21–49m for the same job), so this run's wall total isn't a matched comparison. The setup delta is the stable number.
- **Mirror lane:** every mirror replica passed. The E2E Core mirror and the new Mamba Prefix Cache mirror together cost about one extra job setup over the old unsharded mirror, and each finished well inside its timeout.

Runtime verdict: **pass**. Cost verdict: **pass**.
